intro_text: A career changer after 18 years as a laboratory technician in medical analysis and food safety, I now work across several layers of an industrial ERP: Angular front end, Java/Spring back end and a Frappe ERP. A former quality officer, I build the tools for the job I used to do.
about_text: Eighteen years on the floor in medical analysis and food safety, several of them as a quality officer, then a complete career change. That double reading — the trade on one side, the code on the other — shapes the way I design tools.
projects_text: From wikiwa.com, a platform I design and operate single-handedly, to the business applications delivered during my apprenticeship or as a freelancer: every project is live, and each one taught me something specific.
services_subtitle: From the data model to production
services_text: APIs and business logic, accessible interfaces, deployment and continuous integration. I work just as readily on existing code bases to take over as on projects to start from scratch.
contact_subtitle: An opportunity, a project, a question?
contact_text: Whether it is about a position, an assignment or a technical point, send me a message: I reply quickly.
